_comment: Maps Arma 3 model names (as resolved by the loaded GRM asset config) to Arma Reforger prefab ResourceNames.
A ResourceName looks like "{GUID}Prefabs/.../name.et". The GUID is stable for vanilla assets.
Only the spruce GUID below is confirmed from the Import Objects Extended example file.
To get a GUID for any other prefab: in Enfusion Resource Manager, right-click the .et > Copy resource name.
Models with no mapping are exported WITHOUT a prefab (7-token lines): assign a prefab pool per-layer
in the 'Import Objects Extended' tool UI when importing that layer's .csv.
